steps.en: Find out the exam format, dates and scoring
steps.kg: Экзамендин форматын, мөөнөттөрүн жана баалоосун билиңиз

steps.en: Make a study schedule up to the exam date

steps.en: Study one weak topic per session
steps.kg: Ар бир сабакта бир алсыз теманы окуңуз

steps.en: Solve tasks under time limits
Take a second full practice test

steps.kg: Так сумманы жана максаттуу мөөнөттү белгилеңиз

steps.en: Calculate how much to set aside each month
steps.kg: Ай сайын канча акча бөлүү керектигин эсептеңиз

steps.en: Open a separate savings account

Review the progress at the end of the month
Describe the idea and who it is for in one page

Look at three competitors and note their prices

Show it to the first users
Collect feedback and fix the main problems

steps.en: Announce the launch
Choose one course or book to follow
Define what result means 'learned' for you

steps.en: Go through the first lesson
Practice the basics in short sessions
Make a small project with the new skill

steps.en: Finish the final version and mark it done
steps.kg: Акыркы вариантын бүтүрүп, аткарылды деп белгилеңиз
